nodes.text: Justin comes up to Ben and hands him a gift.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Here you go, Ben! This one's very round!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great... Another gift.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're not excited?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad to get anything, don't get me wrong... But all the gifts I've gotten so far have been... Well, ho-hum.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So far, I've gotten a beaker, a pair of spoons, and a lugnut...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is my Secret Santa saying about me? That I'm a nerd? That I should eat more soup? That my... Tires are loose?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, Scrooge, open this one! I bet you'll like it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? Do you know something about my Santa? Is it one of your friends?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe it is... Just open it!
Ben unwraps the gift...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a... A plastic pumpkin.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You don't like it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Halloween is over.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine! I'll just tell `my friend` she messed up again!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! I'll just tell [color=#3b78e2][i]my friend[/i][/color] she messed up again!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-oh! Is Denni my Santa?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This Secret Santa program is a nightmare!
Ben looks around the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't gotten `one` gift yet!
nodes.text_bbcode: I haven't gotten [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] gift yet!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Neither have I!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd rather have no gift than these insulting ones I've been getting!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: New pom-poms? Hello? I'm `not` on the cheerleading team anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: New pom-poms? Hello? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] on the cheerleading team anymore!

nodes.text: Amanda cries over an open jigsaw puzzle box!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My gift is broken!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It doesn't look like `anyone's` all that happy with their Secret Santa...
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't look like [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone's[/i][/color] all that happy with their Secret Santa...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Awesome! I can't contain my joy about the new `friend` you've made!
nodes.text_bbcode: Awesome! I can't contain my joy about the new [color=#3b78e2][i]friend[/i][/color] you've made!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you jealous? Of Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm not sure how to feel, okay? You didn't seem to mind spending Thanksgiving with her!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's nice to me, that's all...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's just drop it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess shopping for her probably isn't that hard...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just find the most vapid item in the store.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. She's not `that` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. She's not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's just say I'm pretty sure you haven't gotten her any books.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I did look for `Boyfriend Switch, The Novel,` but it turns out no one's written it yet.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I did look for [color=#e23b3b][i]Boyfriend Switch, The Novel,[/i][/color] but it turns out no one's written it yet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm shocked and appalled.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll bet.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's nice to know Denni and I still have some of the same rapport...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely something nerdy! That's who Taylor is `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Definitely something nerdy! That's who Taylor is [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely something cheerleader-y! That's the Taylor `I` know best!
nodes.text_bbcode: Definitely something cheerleader-y! That's the Taylor [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] know best!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know what I want to get her... This entire time I haven't been able to shop for Taylor because I didn't know who she'd become...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Taylor is still the same Taylor, just with slightly different interests!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just need to pick something that would have appealed to the `old` Taylor and combine it with something that'll work for the `new` Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: I just need to pick something that would have appealed to the [color=#e23b3b][i]old[/i][/color] Taylor and combine it with something that'll work for the [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] Taylor!

nodes.text: Howard looks at all the shelves in the variety store. He stops right in front of one and picks up an item.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've got it. This is perfect!
Ben sees Howard from the next aisle over...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wish I could find a gift for Denni that made me `that` happy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish I could find a gift for Denni that made me [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] happy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Ben! It's not that hard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All you have to do is really think about the person you're shopping for...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean, think like Denni?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: As daunting as that sounds... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard... I'll give it a shot!
Howard heads off, happy with his purchase!
What will Taylor think of Howard's gift? Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!
Tons of knick-knacks and gadgets line the shelves, spilling out into the aisles...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This place could get overwhelming... I need to decide right now what kind of gift I'm looking for...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It should be something...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know things are strained between my girlfriend and yours...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But Taylor has plenty of reason to dislike $ZOE, you know? $ZOE didn't have to sabotage Taylor like that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan, this isn't about our girlfriends... I'm just trying to get a good gift for Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Forgive me if I find your kindness suspicious!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Are you going to help me or not?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, I'll help you... `Not!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'll help you... [color=#e23b3b][i]Not![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brendan quickly hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't even get the chance to tell him how lame that was...
An hour or so later, Howard wanders into a variety store called `Gifts and Stuff.`
nodes.text_bbcode: An hour or so later, Howard wanders into a variety store called [b]Gifts and Stuff.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... I'd like that, too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you know what's going on with her?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think she's just upset about all the drama from cheerleading and now...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She's just trying to figure out who she is.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Who is she?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Beats me. Part nerd. Part cheerleader. A little bit of tyrannical maniac mixed in for good measure...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, hey, you know what? I bet you could find a good gift at one of those variety stores. I'd look there. They sell stuff for everyone!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good call! Thanks, Brendan!
A few minutes later, Howard walks into a variety store called `Gifts and Stuff.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A few minutes later, Howard walks into a variety store called [b]Gifts and Stuff.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. Yeah. `Really` sweet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Yeah. [color=#e23b3b][i]Really[/i][/color] sweet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know! $ZOE's going to love me for this!
The next day, Justin stands in front of everyone in his Santa suit!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ho ho ho! Welcome to the last day of the Secret Santa program! There's no need for any more mystery...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Santas! You can reveal your identities!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one got me any gifts!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awww, I'm sorry, $ZOE. I'll get you something for Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you'll probably get me something wonderful, Howard... But I don't understand why my Secret Santa didn't get me anything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it because they think I tried to ruin Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE...
$ZOE turns around.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This ought to be good...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I didn't get you any gifts until now because I know how much you love grand gestures...
Hector hands $ZOE a velvet box...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Please accept this as a pledge for all eternity...
$ZOE opens the box. Inside is a beautiful ring.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector... Are you... Are you proposing?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dude! A pledge for all eternity?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Of friendship! I meant of friendship!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My own best friend!
Howard takes a menacing step toward Hector!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! Don't fight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right, $ZOE, scum like this isn't worth the effort!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Give him back his ring so he can return it to the store in shame...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... It's all so sudden!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... $ZOE, you're not actually considering, are you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not a proposal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector's always been a little like Howard... But, more fun!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Can no one hear me?! It's not a proposal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, Hector! I accept! Let's get married!
Amanda walks into the gym...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! A wedding!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... Who's getting married?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! Hilarious!
Hector turns to Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks for all your help, Spencer! You knew this would happen!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I found `my` gift, no thanks to you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I found [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] gift, no thanks to you!

nodes.text: Hector engaged to $ZOE?! All to Spencer's delight?! What kind of backwards ending is this?!

nodes.text: Earlier that day, Howard watches as Taylor opens her gift...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd rather have no gift than these insulting ones I've been getting!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: New pom-poms? Hello? I'm `not` on the cheerleading team anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: New pom-poms? Hello? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] on the cheerleading team anymore!

nodes.text: A couple of seats away, Howard sinks in his seat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I forgot. Taylor's `no longer` a cheerleader... I know she hangs out with the nerds now. But she's not really a nerd `herself...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I forgot. Taylor's [color=#e23b3b][i]no longer[/i][/color] a cheerleader... I know she hangs out with the nerds now. But she's not really a nerd [color=#e23b3b][i]herself...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How am I supposed to shop for Taylor is I don't even know who she is anymore?
Inside the mall that night, Howard wanders aimlessly past the various shops...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought I might have a better idea once I got here, but I'm still drawing a blank! Looks like I'm going to have to cheat a little...
Howard calls up Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm trying to get a gift for Taylor for Secret Santa.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! I know too much!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's `Secret` Santa, Howard!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]Secret[/i][/color] Santa, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's too late, the cat's out of the bag, and I'm struggling...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just want to...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now we can finally get your gift for $ZOE...
A few minutes later...
In the jewelry store, Hector and Spencer lean over a display case...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A ring?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, that was the plan...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But after seeing all the effort you put into Sam's gift, I'm wondering if I'm overlooking something.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I mean, this `is` the sweet, eye-popping kind of gift Howard would get $ZOE...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, this [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] the sweet, eye-popping kind of gift Howard would get $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She loves jewelry... She'll love this... Right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So? There's already a hundred people in line in front of us...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What difference does one more make?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's the principle!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop being a baby and answer me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is this really the right gift?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How can you call `me` a baby when you can't shut up about whether your dumb gift `says` the right thing?
nodes.text_bbcode: How can you call [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] a baby when you can't shut up about whether your dumb gift [color=#e23b3b][i]says[/i][/color] the right thing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know, I don't think I like you right now.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That makes two of us!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You don't like you either?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! For me, `I` don't like `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! For me, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] don't like [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's just wait in line in silence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer reaches out and spins $Travis around, grabbing him by the shirt collar!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You got a problem with my shoes, son?!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Your shoes? No! What's wrong with them?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh! So there's something wrong with them?!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: No! That's not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Tell you what. I'll make you a deal. You get out of my sight, I'll let you live.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sounds good!
Spencer lets go of $Travis, and $Travis flees the store!
Next in line is Dex, who nervously turns around.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Would you two like to step in line ahead of me? I'm only buying these tree lights, several reams of wrapping paper, and a complete set of Ogres 'N' Elves themed ornaments.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure! Thanks!
Hector and Spencer step past him. The guy in front of them lets them pass too!

nodes.speaker: Nerd
nodes.text: I love your shoes!
This continues all the way to the very front of the line, where Spencer pays for his ornament.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sweet!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Heh. I didn't think so.
$Travis turns back around. Hector nudges Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That gorilla, $Travis, just...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay... You probably have a better idea of what Sam wants anyway...
Hector and Spencer head for the cashier...
And find themselves at the end of a `long` line of holiday shoppers!
nodes.text_bbcode: And find themselves at the end of a [b]long[/b] line of holiday shoppers!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is the worst!
Spencer's attention is on his gift...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I hope Samface likes this...
Just then, $Travis cuts in line in front of them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Is there a problem?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! There is! Tell him, Spencer!
Hector turns to Spencer but finds him lost in thought...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't want her to read too much into it... What if she thinks I want us to wrestle?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure... It's your funeral.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is a selfish gift, bro! It says, 'I was mindlessly lurching through a store, and I saw a sport I like.'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It does?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah? But if you get this picture frame ornament, it says, 'Hey, Samhead...'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Samface!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right, sorry. 'Hey, Samface, remember this memory of us. We had good times, didn't we?'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right. Fine. I'll get yours.
Spencer buys the picture frame ornament...
The next day, Justin stands in front of everyone in his Santa suit!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ho ho ho! Welcome to the last day of the Secret Santa program! There's no need for any more mystery...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Santas! You can reveal your identities!
Hector watches from the other side of the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did anyone get me a gift?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And here's where the magic happens!
Spencer taps Sam on the shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm your Secret Santa. Sorry for taking so long. I wanted your gift to be special.
He hands Sam his gift. She opens it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is this?! An ornament with a picture of us together at the zoo?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's wrong with that? I like animals!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is a picture we took `when we were dating!` The frame is `heart-shaped!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a picture we took [color=#3b78e2][i]when we were dating![/i][/color] The frame is [color=#3b78e2][i]heart-shaped![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's the only one I could find...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Spencer, this is totally inappropriate! You're not going to convince me to get back together with you!
The gym gets quiet.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh-oh!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who said anything about getting back together?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `thought` we broke up peacefully, but I guess I wasn't clear about my feelings!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] we broke up peacefully, but I guess I wasn't clear about my feelings!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand why you're acting like this! I just wanted you to think of the good times we had!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What good times? All I remember is you talking only about football or stupid wrestling or your `dumb shoes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What good times? All I remember is you talking only about football or stupid wrestling or your [color=#3b78e2][i]dumb shoes![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone in the gym gasps!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did you say about my shoes?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You heard me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Say it again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't say it... Don't say it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I said your shoes... Are the most ridiculous, ugly, pieces of foot-garbage I've ever had the misfortune to lay my eyes on. `They are dumb!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said your shoes... Are the most ridiculous, ugly, pieces of foot-garbage I've ever had the misfortune to lay my eyes on. [color=#3b78e2][i]They are dumb![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's what I thought you said...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please get it through that thick head of yours! `We are not a couple!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Please get it through that thick head of yours! [color=#3b78e2][i]We are not a couple![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam marches off! Spencer turns and faces Hector!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You! You're dead!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gulp!
Sam broke up with Spencer... Again! This time a lot harsher `and` in front of the whole school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam broke up with Spencer... Again! This time a lot harsher [b]and[/b] in front of the whole school!

nodes.text: Hector probably didn't want that to happen... And he probably didn't want to become the target of Spencer's wrath!
Play again and see if you can help Hector give Spencer the right gift-buying advice!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's go.
Two hours later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's it! We've been in eight hundred stores, and you haven't liked `one` gift!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! We've been in eight hundred stores, and you haven't liked [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] gift!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It has to be perfect!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you trying to bring back 'Spencer and Sam', or as I like to call you, `Spammer?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you trying to bring back 'Spencer and Sam', or as I like to call you, [color=#e23b3b][i]Spammer?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No... I just want to make sure that Sam and I are still cool, you know?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The gift has to say, 'Hey, Samface, we're friends. Nothing more, nothing less.'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I want her to know that I'm not going to pull a Surf 'N' Turf Murph...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He became a villain when Slamazon divorced him for his arch-nemesis, Tax Man Daniels!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, no one wants `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, no one wants [color=#e23b3b][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, my feet can't handle any more aimless walking... So we're finding your gift in this `ornament shop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, my feet can't handle any more aimless walking... So we're finding your gift in this [color=#e23b3b][i]ornament shop![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, my shoes are getting a little scuffed...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And an ornament might be perfect!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look at this!
Spencer picks up an ornament with a pair of wrestlers on it, one male, one female.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's like me and Samface!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I really hope not... For a wide variety of anatomical reasons...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And besides, chicks don't really like wrestling. What about something like this?
Hector holds up an ornament with a small, heart-shaped picture frame on it.

nodes.speaker: Hector

nodes.text: Grr!

Score Up!

nodes.text: No problem! I just can't believe there's a place that actually `sells` used socks.
nodes.text_bbcode: No problem! I just can't believe there's a place that actually [color=#e23b3b][i]sells[/i][/color] used socks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a gag gift store. Only Ryan's been using it for actual gifts for Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't stand this! I'm just going to get Denni a gift even though I'm not her Secret Santa!

nodes.text: Something that will make her forget about Ryan's awful gifts and really lift her spirits.
Ben notices the gift Brendan bought...

nodes.text: So, you're the one who's been getting gifts for Amanda?

nodes.text: Unfortunately.

nodes.text: Else?

nodes.text: I never noticed that!

nodes.text: Guess I'll have to buy a few more gifts...

nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.text: And Denni's downward spiral of jealousy could be legitimate!

nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That's[/i][/color] your tactic?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I saw it in a movie once! The protagonist pointed out all his own problems so his enemies had no ammo against him!

nodes.text: Was he an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Urrrr... Kind of...

nodes.text: Heh! I've never had a nerd teammate before! Thanks for the help making fun of the doofus here!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Ben...

nodes.text: Based on that gift you're holding, I'm assuming you're Amanda's Secret Santa...

nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.text: She's not going to like it. It's not special enough.

nodes.speaker: Brendan

nodes.text: Maybe I need to go bigger...

nodes.text: It's my new best friend!

nodes.text: Uh, dude, how can you afford to buy a pony?

nodes.text: I can't! I'm just renting it for the hour!

nodes.text: Ooooh...

nodes.speaker: Brendan

nodes.text: Bad, Mr. Chuckles! We do that in the restroom!

nodes.text: She's already named it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry to tell you, but Amanda doesn't really understand the concept of 'renting'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! Why is hindsight so much clearer than foresight?!
Fifty nine minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Amanda. Hey, Mr. Chuckles.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thank you for uniting us, Brendan! You're the greatest person I'll ever meet!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, about that... You're... You're going to have to give the pony back now, Amanda.

nodes.text: What? But Mr. Chuckles and I are best friends!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know... It's just... The hour's over.
Brendan reaches for the pony's reins...

nodes.text: Attack, Mr. Chuckles!
The pony snaps at Brendan's hand!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You turned it into an attack pony in an hour?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mr. Chuckles is a self-defense pony! You can't take him from me! None of you can!
Amanda gives Hector a final look...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Hector... But you understand what I have to do, right?
Hector nods solemnly, tears welling in his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Ride, Manda-Panda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yah, Chuckles!
Amanda steers the pony out the door and into the sunset...

nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me, Ben. Denni [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] jewelry. She's a girl, it's in her blood!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What was that sound?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... Um, I just saw something funny on TV.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, heh. Cool.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just following some shopping advice.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No offense, but whoever's advising you doesn't know what they're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, they suck.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If there's anything we've learned today, dogg, it's making sure you find that right gift.

nodes.text: You should try Gifts and Stuff. We saw some gifts Denni might like there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Some stuff too...

nodes.text: Okay! Thanks, guys!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All these mall stores look the same to me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've got it. This is perfect!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wish I could find a gift that made me `that` happy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish I could find a gift that made me [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] happy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Ben! It's not that hard.

nodes.text: All you have to do is get into the character of the person you're shopping for...

nodes.speaker: Ben

nodes.speaker: Ben

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... How'd it go, Ben? What'd you get her? Some earrings? A pendant?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Errr... No. I didn't get her anything at the jewelry store or at Gifts and Stuff.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gifts and Stuff? That's where you'd go if you were shopping for nobodies!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm actually thinking now that it might be better to... To make a gift myself! What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's... That's...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's perfect!

nodes.text: But I'm not sure what to make? Any ideas?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Tons! But one question first...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can you knit?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry... It isn't hard...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look at this!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's like me and Samface!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I really hope not... For a wide variety of anatomical reasons...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And besides, chicks don't really like wrestling. What about something like this?
Hector holds up an ornament with a small, heart-shaped picture frame on it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You could put a picture of the two of you in there. I know Amanda would love this kind of thing!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know... I think I'm going to get the wrestling one...

options.label: Let him buy the wrestling ornament!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ben's in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! That means it's true!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Your girlfriend's going to break up with you!
Brendan strides over!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Ryan, you're...
Ben goes home and sits down at the long dining room table, his laptop open to a video on knitting...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... What am I doing? Even if I miraculously learn how to knit, the sweater will still be hideous and over-sized. Denni would never wear it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I know what she `would` wear!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I know what she [color=#e23b3b][i]would[/i][/color] wear!

nodes.text: An hour later, Denni comes into Ben's house. She's holding a cup of coffee.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I like this place better when it isn't brimming with cheerleaders. Pom-poms are bad for feng shui.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. What's with the coffee?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm vacationing with my family after the Secret Santa exchange tomorrow... I want to be really tired for the plane flight so I can just sleep through it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've got to say, I'm really not looking forward to the joy of opening up one more offensive gift before I leave.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm still kind of mad at you... So... What's the super important thing?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Close your eyes and hold out your hands.
Denni puts down her mug and holds out her hands. Ben hands her a bottle of perfume. She opens her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... Is it just me, or do you keep giving me gifts that are meant for a diva?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not what you think!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I used my dad's flavor laboratory to create a perfume that is specific to you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That... That sounds... Actually kind of cool.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The real question is... Does it smell amazing?
Denni spritzes some of the perfume onto her wrist...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mmmm! I love it! It smells like a record store that only sells music that hasn't gotten cool yet!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I call it `Purple Kiss.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I call it [color=#e23b3b][i]Purple Kiss.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I can't believe you made this for me... That's `so` nice of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I can't believe you made this for me... That's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] nice of you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I have a confession to make...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know you're my Secret Santa.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I figured... I know it seems like I am the `worst` Santa. Like I'm wearing a blue coat instead of a red one, and like I didn't even check to see who's been naughty or nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: I figured... I know it seems like I am the [color=#3b78e2][i]worst[/i][/color] Santa. Like I'm wearing a blue coat instead of a red one, and like I didn't even check to see who's been naughty or nice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. I haven't been that easy of a recipient.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... You got me a beaker, some spoons, and a lugnut. Care to explain?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was about to...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The beaker is from the chemistry class where we first met...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I got you the spoons 'cause I figured you'd need some after you gave yours to Howard's twin sisters on Halloween...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My collection was two spoons short...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And the lugnut is actually from the tire of Steve's van.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Steve... From Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah... The van I pretended to kiss you against... Which was parked in the parking lot where we had our first kiss...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And the pumpkin?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: To remind you of our second kiss.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... You win... You're a great Santa!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry I've been so jealous lately...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I'm sorry I haven't been there for you as much as I should...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Want to stay up with me for a while?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure... How could I resist you when you're wearing Purple Kiss?!
Ben leans toward her and kisses her softly.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mmmm...
They stay up late, talking and enjoying each other's company. Eventually...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow! It's late... Or early! I've gotta go home! Bye, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I love you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I love you, Denni! Goodbye!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That worked out really well! I guess I `am` pretty good at getting gifts for people and...)
nodes.text_bbcode: That worked out really well! I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] pretty good at getting gifts for people and...)

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! I forgot to get a gift for Jessica for Secret Santa today!
Ben scrambles to his father's lab equipment...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni liked her perfume so much! I bet I can make a perfume for Jessica that `she'll` like too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Denni liked her perfume so much! I bet I can make a perfume for Jessica that [color=#e23b3b][i]she'll[/i][/color] like too!

nodes.text: He quickly mixes together a few chemicals but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! It's not working!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need more time...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There is no time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's humongous!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not good with size yet...

nodes.speaker: Denni

nodes.text: I didn't have very many colors at my disposal...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was supposed to be a reindeer...

nodes.speaker: Denni

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: 'Tis the season.

nodes.speaker: Ben

nodes.text: Ben knit me an ugly sweater...

nodes.text: I don't care about you at all.

And you bought him this... So he knows where to go in an emergency?

Now we can be all official.
